principle: Choose a granular face profile independently from non-face realism. Beauty, age and character specificity may outrank maximal facial photorealism.

prompt_translation: Keep the face beauty-first, clean and elegant while preserving the reference age; do not age the character up in the name of realism.
Preserve the reference face shape, cheek volume, eye spacing and natural eyelids with delicate makeup; do not impose a generic oval face.
Use restrained regional skin reflection while keeping the approved facial identity and apparent age.
Keep the face beautiful first, but preserve character-specific facial identity rather than averaging it into a generic AI beauty face.

Retain the reference cheek volume, underlying eyelid structure and distinctive nose-and-lip features. Allow natural expression movement when requested; select gaze, facial tension and mouth action for the current character and task rather than freezing the original expression or imposing a smile.
Add only restrained regional skin response and soft-tissue realism; do not increase maturity, fatigue or facial severity.
Increase believable human facial presence while keeping the character attractive, identity-stable and consistent with the approved apparent age.
Use realistic eyelid structure, regional skin optics and natural nose/lip anatomy without pushing the face toward mature documentary realism.
Use strong photographic human presence while preserving the approved identity and attractiveness.
Keep realistic facial planes, soft tissue, eye optics and skin response coherent with a premium studio portrait.
Preserve intentionally stylized beauty and idealized facial appeal with minimal realism pressure on the face.
Keep the observed facial geometry and age while retaining intentionally simplified skin shading and controlled luminous highlights.
